crs_verification.method: Compare all 16 sheet bounds with 0.005 degree sheet grid around Wolgok; EPSG:5186 matches. EPSG:5181/5174/5179 place sheets outside stated map area. No fitted translation or manual coordinate offset.
crs_verification.limitation: XML declares only GRS80; exact projected CRS is inferred from coordinates and sheet layout, not explicitly supplied in metadata.
